_provenance: awslabs.s3-tables-mcp-server@0.1.1 (PyPI, uploaded 2026-09-08; requires_python >=3.11). NOT a live recording: no AWS account was available when this was written (2026-10-07). Derived from that exact version's published sdist (server.py) and from how mcp 2.0.0's func_metadata renders a signature; pydantic `title` keys are left out, and append_rows_to_table's table_name pattern (constants.TABLE_NAME_PATTERN) was not copied. `query` carries default null and is therefore not required in the schema, although the tool fails without it. PARTIAL: the server registers more tools (table buckets, namespaces, imports …); only the three the routes use are listed here. Re-record with a live `tools/list` when an operator profile is available.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all S3 tables across all table buckets and namespaces.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Execute SQL queries against S3 Tables using PyIceberg/Daft.

tools.name: append_rows_to_table
tools.description: Append rows to an Iceberg table using PyIceberg/Daft.
